- **Story:** As Dana, I want a list endpoint that lists without any extra input, so that a client calls it the way a real client would.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given ListTasks, When it is written with no available input, Then the endpoint takes no body, lists the stored tasks, and its specs cover Zero, One and Many tasks in order
  2. Given a declared failure for the list, When one is needed, Then it comes from the store or an effect failure the spec can provoke (for example an unavailable store double), not from a caller flag, or the failure spec is dropped and the endpoint has success specs only if no honest failure exists (recorded in the card)
  3. Given the other endpoints, When this card is merged, Then their specs, the generated build and the live HTTP behaviour are unchanged
